evidence.name: Screen field: Purchase button gradient
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Purchase button gradient" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Purchase button gradient
sections.description: Optionally lays a color gradient over the button's solid background for a richer call-to-action. Pick Simple (two colors), Medium (two colors plus an angle), or Advanced (multiple color stops, with an optional shimmer). Use it to make your main CTA pop; leave it off if a flat color already stands out.
